newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Tysan shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Tysan shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of construction concern Tysan Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Thursday.
Tysan shares ended at HK$1.76 per share on Wednesday.

The company said on Wednesday it became the controlling shareholder of Tianjin International Building, a commerical and residential complex in Tianjin in northeastern China, by investing HK$103 million to raise its stake in the development.
It said it would fund the acquisition by the net proceeds raised from the recent disposal of a Hong Kong investment property at King's Road in the Quarry Bay district.
Tysan is engaged in foundation works, the hiring and trading of construction machinery, and property investment and development.
